kevin: Support found a customer flow where repeated 429s + context trimming during an embeddings migration produced unreadable output. Our error-ref mentions fallbacks but has no ready SDK snippet. Can we add a tiny copy-paste pattern + a 5-bullet runbook?

sarah: Ill draft both Python and JS minimal examples. Keep them ~6 lines.

maya: Include telemetry suggestions: tag retries with retry_reason and fallback_model.

sarah: Python draft:
```python
try:
  out = client.generate(model="redwood-large-v1", prompt=big_prompt, max_tokens=1024)
except RateLimitError:
  client.metrics.increment('client.retry', tags={'retry_reason':'context_trim'})
  short = trim_context(big_prompt, keep_last_tokens=2048)
  out = client.generate(model="redwood-small-v1", prompt=short, max_tokens=256)
```

jordan: Add a one-paragraph note: tradeoffs (quality vs latency/cost) and when not to auto-downgrade (sensitive/legal content).

sarah: Runbook bullets (5): reproduce minimal case; confirm 429s vs infra; try local trim; add snippet; monitor Console fallback rate.

docs-bot: Link checker: flagged /old-error-ref -> suggest /error-reference/429.

sarah: Fixed link in PR. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900 — includes JS sample with backoff, telemetry note, and runbook.

kevin: LGTM, approving once JS backoff example is present. Thanks everyone.

maya: I'll add a changelog line after merge: "Added 429 + context-trim runbook and SDK fallback snippets (Python/JS)"

kevin: Closing. If support sees more repros well iterate on instrumentation.
